name: Planar Adaptation
levelText: alchemist 5, arcanist 5, cleric 4, investigator 5, medium 4, occultist 4, oracle 4, psychic 4, sorcerer 5, spiritualist 5, summoner 5, summoner (unchained) 5, warpriest 4, wizard 5
description: Planar adaptation grants you immunity to the harmful environmental effects of a particular plane of existence, including such hazards as toxicity, extreme temperatures, and lack of air. Additionally, you gain energy resistance 20 to a single energy type prevalent on that plane (choose one if more than one type is equally prevalent). Planar adaptation has no effect when cast upon your native plane.
